label: Copper as Share of Total Exports
delta: LME hit a new all-time record of US$6.736/lb on Aug 17, 2026 (+40% YoY), extending the Aug 6 record of US$6.557/lb; rally now driven by AI-infrastructure demand and expected cathode tariffs on top of DR Congo's copper/cobalt export ban; Dipres projects a record US$8.04B in mining payments to the Treasury in 2026. Copper closed Sep 8–9 at US$14,737/tonne (~US$6.68/lb), its second-highest close on record, as US tariff fears and Chile/Peru supply constraints (Chilean output down 9.4% YoY in July after storm damage) met sustained Chinese demand

label: Years of Democratic Governance (Post-1990)
source: Biblioteca del Congreso Nacional de Chile
delta: Six months into Kast's term (inaugurated Mar 11), unemployment reached 9.5% in the May–July quarter (~981,000 people) — the highest in five years and in Latin America — while August CPI hit 4.1% YoY (up from 3.5% in July) and the Central Bank's September IPoM cut its 2026 growth forecast to 0.25%–0.75%. Government turnover reached 48 departures (38 at seremi level) by Sep 17, including three regional secretaries in a single week over management failures and a since-disavowed remark on elderly care. Kast tried to reset the narrative for Fiestas Patrias: a Sep 14 'digital chain' address, a Sep 15 US$6B four-year CAF investment agenda and a labor-emergency-plan preview to coalition leaders, his first presidential cueca at the Parque O'Higgins fondas (Sep 16), a first Ecumenical Te Deum where Cardinal Chomalí pressed him on corruption and 'the vulnerable' (Sep 18), and his first Gran Parada Militar leading 10,206 troops — the largest lineup in 17 years — on Sep 19
